blurb: Wilmington Brew Works operates two taprooms in Wilmington, DE, offering award-winning craft beer and cider. Guests can enjoy various events such as trivia nights, board game socials, skee-ball tournaments, and live music. The brewery also offers online growler and crowler filling for taproom pickup.
